description: Custom Linux distribution based on Arch Linux, designed for the needs of tertiary educb for unation.
description_part_2: Developed by students from Open Source UoM community, UniOS offers a consistent, safe and ready-to-use KDE Plasma environment, ideal both for university labs and for every user's personal computer.
linux_for_students: Linux for students: Ready to use from the first boot, with immediate access to all the tools each student needs based on their department, on every university computer as well as your personal laptop.
unibackpack_description: Designed to make it easy to install specialized software based on the university, school or department. It provides immediate access to the digital tools required for every student's studies.
unimate_description: A web-based tool that creates ready-to-use installation scripts for every Linux distribution. It allows users to select the applications they want and install them in bulk.
unidesk_description: A utility application that provides a consistent and tested working environment on every computer. It eliminates compatibility issues between labs and personal devices.
unios_ppa_description: The official software repository, open to suggestions, bug reports and fixes from the community. Every contribution is valuable to the project's development.
team_description: Built by students from University of Macedonia, as part of the Open Source UoM community.
faq_description: Answers to your most frequently questions about UniOS.
what's_unios_A: A: UniOS is a custom Linux distribution for greek universities based on Arch Linux, developed by Open Source UoM. It's purpose is to offer a user-friendly environment for students, while promoting the open-source philosophy.
compatible_computers_Q: Q: Which computers are compatible with UniOS?
compatible_computers_A: A: UniOS is designed for x86-64 computers. It requires at least a dual-core CPU, 4 GB of RAM, and 25 GB of storage.
contribute_Q: Q: Is it possible to contribute to UniOS project;
contribute_A: A: Of course. UniOS is an open source software and is developed by Open Source UoM. Contribution can be done through GitHub. Moreover, it is possible to contact us to join the official community server on Discord!
desktop_environment_Q: Q: What desktop environment UniOS uses;
desktop_environment_A: A: UniOS uses KDE Plasma with Breeze Dark theme, set for academic usage.
broken_computers: Three laptops and one desktop broke during the development of this project.
